name: Lopes' Marching Cubes with Critical Isovalues
aliases: Topologically Correct Marching Cubes based on Lopes
definition: A topologically correct Marching Cubes variant that handles critical isovalues by using topological polygons (TPs), shoulder points, and inflection points to correctly represent tunnels and degenerate cases in trilinear cells.
summary: Lopes' Marching Cubes with Critical Isovalues is a topologically correct surface extraction method that handles critical isovalues using topological polygons, shoulder points, and inflection points to resolve ambiguities in trilinear cells.
